title: Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regard to the behaviour of the structure of the impacted vehicle in a rear-end collision
scope_summary: Approves a vehicle type with regard to the behaviour of the structure of the passenger compartment in a rear-end collision, verified by a rear impact test with a moving barrier or pendulum impactor. It applies to vehicles of category M1.
scope_quote: This Regulation applies to vehicles of category M1 with regard to their behaviour in a rear-end collision.
applies_to_components: part of the vehicle rearward of the transverse plane through the "R" point of the rearmost seat (structure, dimensions, lines, material)
lines and inside dimensions of the passenger compartment
engine siting (front, rear, centre) as a type-defining characteristic
relation_to_other_regulations: Vehicle category M1 as defined in Annex 7 to the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3), TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.1/Amend.2
Annex 3 ('H' point and torso angle determination) refers to the SAE J826 3-D H machine for construction details
Approval mark may be combined with marks of other Regulations under which the vehicle is approved in the same country (para. 4.5)
Annex 4 para. 4 allows equivalent test methods as alternatives to the prescribed impact test
Original series 00; no replacement of other Regulations stated in the provided text

defined_terms.label: Transverse plane
defined_terms.definition: A vertical plane perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

defined_terms.label: Longitudinal plane
defined_terms.definition: A plane parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

defined_terms.label: Vehicle reference plane
defined_terms.definition: A plane related to the vehicle and horizontal when the vehicle at unladen kerb weight rests on a horizontal plane.

defined_terms.label: Approval of a vehicle
defined_terms.definition: The approval of a vehicle type with regard to the behaviour of the structure of the passenger compartment in a rear-end collision.

defined_terms.label: Vehicle type
defined_terms.definition: Power-driven vehicles not differing in length and width, structure/dimensions/lines/material rearward of the transverse plane through the 'R' point of the rearmost seat, passenger-compartment lines and inside dimensions (as far as affecting the impact test), and engine siting.

defined_terms.label: Passenger compartment
defined_terms.definition: The space for occupant accommodation bounded by the roof, floor, side walls, doors, outside glazing, front bulkhead and the plane of the rear compartment bulkhead or rear seat back support.

defined_terms.label: Unladen kerb weight
defined_terms.definition: The weight of the vehicle in running order, unoccupied and unladen but complete with fuel, coolant, lubricant, tools and a spare wheel if provided as standard.

defined_terms.label: Capacity of the fuel tank
defined_terms.definition: The fuel-tank capacity as specified by the manufacturer.

defined_terms.label: H point and R point (Annex 3)
defined_terms.definition: Seating reference points of the occupant/seat used to locate the rearmost seat position, determined with the 3-D H machine per Annex 3.

classes_and_variants.name: Moving barrier impactor test
classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: Rear impact applied by a moving barrier carrying the impactor (Annex 4, 2.4)

classes_and_variants.name: Pendulum impactor test
classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: Rear impact applied by a pendulum carrying the impactor (Annex 4, 2.5)

classes_and_variants.name: Equivalent test methods
classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: Alternative methods accepted if equivalence is demonstrated (Annex 4, 4)

classes_and_variants.distinguished_by: Front, rear or centre engine position constitutes a different vehicle type

applicability_hints: Approval is of the whole M1 vehicle type, not of a separate component; components are relevant only insofar as they affect rear-impact behaviour of the passenger compartment structure

Any change to structure, dimensions, lines or material rearward of the transverse plane through the 'R' point of the rearmost seat (e.g. rear body panels, rear cross-members, bumper beams, rear floor, tailgate, rear seat mounting position) can create a new vehicle type or require extension
Changes to passenger compartment inside dimensions, vehicle length/width, or engine position (front/rear/centre) also define the vehicle type
Rear seat position/back support matters because the 'R' point of the rearmost seat and the rear seat back plane bound the evaluated zone
Fuel tank fill state is part of the test vehicle condition, so rear-mounted fuel tanks and their surroundings are relevant to the test setup
Applies only to M1; other categories (N1, M2, etc.) are not covered
